entries.title: Psalms 87:1
segments: A Psalm for the sons of Korah, A Song. His foundation [is] in the holy mountains.

entries.title: Psalms 87:2
segments: The LORD loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.

entries.title: Psalms 87:3
segments: Glorious things [are] spoken of you, O city of God. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 87:4
segments: I will mention Rahab and Babylon to those who know me; behold, Philistia and Tyre, with Ethiopia; this [man] was born there.

entries.title: Psalms 87:5
segments: And to Zion it shall be said, [This] man and [that] man was born in her; and the Highest shall establish her.

entries.title: Psalms 87:6
segments: The LORD shall count, in recording the peoples, [that] this [man] was born there. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 87:7
segments: And the singers, the players of the pipe: all my springs [are] in You!
